notes.title: A new version is available on Steam (v1.4.11)
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40082767/771ac494da8a4bd6347dae34d55194049049faa2.png[/img]

I know the game is old but from time to time when I find time I go back to old games and update them. Most updates appear on the day of release and after release, thanks for the feedback and opinions left. In the next update I will add a no lives mode (relax mode).

A new version is available on Steam (v1.4.11):

- Fixed 1 MILLION and 2 MILLION achievements
- Some fixes for gamepads
- Windows 32 and 64 bit, Linux 32 and 64 bit, Mac 64 bit update
- Other minor fixes

Full changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1540330/discussions/0/4917340730756208550/

[spoiler]I wonder if Mumba's fans are still alive? :D[/spoiler]

notes.title: New version is available on Steam (v1.4.10)
notes.notes:
Hello, thanks for feedback! New updates will be available after 2022. This is the last update THIS YEAR :D (v1.4.10):

- Some levels have been balanced
- 8 start lives
- All bosses HP decreased by 15-20%
- Fixed some achievements
- Fixed in some "trap" levels
- Fixed highscores for some players
- Modify "mini director"
- Windows 32 and 64 bit, Linux 32 and 64 bit, Mac 64 bit update
- Other minor fixes

If there are any problems or you have suggestions let me know in the forum, in a comment or review. Thanks.

Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1540330/discussions/0/4917340730756208550/

notes.title: New version is available on Steam (v1.3.9)
notes.notes:
Hello, thanks for feedback! In new updates I will add "Relax mode" (no lives) and Survival mode :D. BTW the new version is available on Steam (v1.3.9):

- 2 new lives to start
- Changes to the physics engine
- Fixed the Scarab
- Added "crash" on some levels
- Some levels have been balanced
- Randomness is reduced, a mini director has been added
- Windows 32 and 64 bit, Linux 32 and 64 bit, Mac 64 bit update
- Other minor fixes

If there are any problems or you have suggestions let me know in the forum, in a comment or review. Thanks.

Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1540330/discussions/0/4917340730756208550/
